Our Purpose

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

Have many careers in one Firm.
Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

What will your typical day look like?

Work you'll do

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

The Director, Data Management Capabilities & AI Readiness is responsible for defining and leading the strategy, operating model, and delivery of enterprise data management capabilities.

The role is the business owner for cross-domain data management capabilities that serve the Deloitte network, including Master Data Management (MDM), Metadata Management, Data Quality, Taxonomy Management, Reference Data, and Data Modeling.

Working across global applications, business functions, architecture teams, product organizations, and operational teams, the Director will establish scalable data management capabilities, drive adoption of enterprise standards and procedures, and develop trusted data assets for business operations, analytics, AI, regulatory compliance, and decision-making.

This leader serves as a key connector between business executives, application owners, enterprise architects, operations leaders, and technology teams, aligning diverse stakeholder perspectives and driving consensus on complex data management decisions across a global organization. This role is expected to establish measurable outcomes, monitor performance, and continuously evolve enterprise data management capabilities to an aligned target state and maturity model that the role will also define and govern.

The DSGO is responsible for building an integrated strategy and operating model to manage global data and AI products across their lifecycle, enabling better business outcomes, innovation, and client service.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & Leadership
Define and execute the data management strategy for:
Master Data Management
Metadata Management
Ontology and Context Management
Data Quality
Taxonomy and Reference Data
Enterprise Data Models

Develop multi-year roadmaps that align to business priorities, digital transformation objectives, and AI enablement goals.
Establish and evolve enterprise operating models, governance forums, stewardship structures, and accountability frameworks.
Champion the importance of trusted, governed data as a strategic enterprise asset.
Lead a global team of data management professionals and subject matter experts.
Data Management Operating Model Development
Design and implement sustainable operating models supporting global and regional data domains.
Define roles, responsibilities, decision rights, escalation paths, and governance forums.
Build effective collaboration models between:
Business teams
Application owners
Product teams
Enterprise Architecture
Operations teams
Data and analytics functions

Establish service delivery models that enable consistent execution across multiple geographies and applications.
Drive adoption of standardized data management processes for, metadata, data quality, data architecture, taxonomy, and data quality remediation.
Master Data & Reference Data Management
Lead enterprise master data governance programs across key domains such as Customer, Vendor, Products, and People.
Define authoritative sources, golden record strategies, hierarchy management approaches, and lifecycle management approaches.
Establish data management practices for reference data and shared enterprise dimensions.
Partner with business and technology leaders to modernize master data capabilities and improve operational efficiency.
Metadata, Taxonomy & Data Modeling
Establish enterprise metadata management capabilities including technical, operational, and AI metadata.
Enable the integration of business glossaries and semantic frameworks across applications and data products.
Lead development of conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling standards.
Ensure enterprise data structures support interoperability, analytics, AI, and future platform modernization initiatives.
Data Quality & Measurement
Lead enterprise data quality management capabilities including strategy, frameworks, procedures, monitoring, and remediation
Operationalize quality dimensions, monitoring capabilities, issue management processes, and continuous improvement practices.
Partner with business and technology teams to improve the quality, consistency, integrity and usability of enterprise data across critical business domains.
Define and implement enterprise measurement frameworks, KPIs, and scorecards to assess the effectiveness and maturity of data management capabilities, including data issue resolution and remediation
Build executive dashboards and performance reporting that provide visibility into enterprise data health, operational performance, risks, and business outcomes.
Drive continuous improvement programs using quantitative performance measures, automation and operational metrics to increase the effectiveness of enterprise data management.
Stakeholder Management & Executive Influence
Build trusted relationships with senior executives, business leaders, product leaders, architects, and operations leaders.
Facilitate decision-making across highly complex environments with competing priorities and differing viewpoints.
Lead discussions where stakeholder opinions may be polarized and drive alignment toward enterprise outcomes.
Negotiate priorities, funding, resource commitments, and roadmap decisions across organizational boundaries.
Influence and build consensus without authority in a highly matrixed global environment.
Present program strategy, risks, decisions, and results to executive and governance forums.
Innovation & Capability Development
Identify new capabilities required to support enterprise data and AI strategies.
Evaluate emerging technologies, tools, and operating practices.
Lead modernization initiatives related to:
Data governance
Metadata platforms
Data quality tooling
Master data platforms
AI-ready data foundations
AI-auditability for data assets

Build communities of practice and increase organizational data management maturity

About The Team

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in "what is" but rather "what can be" to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

Enough About Us, Let’s Talk About You

Key Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Data Management, Business, or related discipline. Master's degree preferred.
12+ years of experience in enterprise data management, data governance, data architecture, or related disciplines.
7+ years leading global teams and enterprise-scale transformation initiatives.
Proven leadership of master data, metadata, data quality, taxonomy, or data governance programs as the voice of the business with technical teams, particularly for cross-domain data assets. Experience with data governance tools such as Informatica, SAP MDG, Collibra, Databricks Unity Catalog, etc.
Experience establishing operating models and governance frameworks across multiple business units and geographies. Experience working closely with application and operations teams in large, federated organizations.
Confident communicator with the ability to engage effectively with executive leadership teams. Able to translate complex data concepts into business outcomes.
Ability to build strong relationships across organizational boundaries, acting as a trusted advisor to executives, business leaders, architects, product teams, and internal customers represented across multiple geographies.
Demonstrated experience navigating politically complex environments and skilled at facilitating alignment where competing objectives exist, to successfully balance enterprise objectives with individual stakeholder requirements.
Connects enterprise data capabilities to business strategy, operational effectiveness, and AI enablement by establishing measurable outcomes and accountability structures.
Drives execution through governance, influence, and disciplined delivery management leading direct reports and dotted line teams.

Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $140,000 - $260,000, and individuals may be eligible to participate in our bonus program. Deloitte is fair and competitive when it comes to the salaries of our people. We regularly benchmark across a variety of positions, industries, sectors, targets, and levels. Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.

Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life.

Be yourself, and more.

We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.

You Shape How We Make Impact.

Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute.

Be the leader you want to be

Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.

Have as many careers as you want.

We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors.

The next step is yours

jobs.title: Sales Director for Cloud & AI
jobs.description:
Overview

Overview

Are you curious and deeply passionate about technology and sales, and ready to tackle complex challenges in a dynamic environment in the era of AI? Are you passionate about empowering financial sector customers to achieve more with technology and help them succeed in their digital transformation?If so, we invite you to join our Canadian team as a Solution Sales Director for Cloud & AI
at Microsoft. In this role, you will be at the forefront of innovation, working on cutting‑edge projects that leverage the latest cloud and AI technologies to drive meaningful impact for citizens and a variety of industries. Join us and be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning. Microsoft believes that our Canadian organizations have a unique opportunity to transform society at scale. From central government and agencies to local authorities, healthcare institutions and education, these organizations are reinventing how they deliver secure, trusted and efficient services to citizens. With Microsoft Cloud, we aspire to empower every finance sector organization to innovate and modernize on our platform, while meeting the highest standards of security, compliance and digital sovereignty.

Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Deal Execution

Lead the sales team responsible for driving Cloud & AI revenue across accounts, ensuring disciplined execution of the end‑to‑end sales cycle (prospection → qualification → deal shaping → closing).
Ensure teams adhere to Microsoft sales methodologies (including AI‑enhanced sales frameworks) to qualify opportunities, accelerate deal velocity and improve win rates.
Orchestrate complex deal cycles involving procurement, multi‑stakeholder governance, and compliance constraints typical of the French Financial Sector.
Coach sellers on how to engage, influence and secure executive alignment with C‑level decision makers (CEO, CIO, CTO/CDO, Business Line Leaders) to land Microsoft Cloud value propositions.
Drive competitive positioning, ensuring the team can clearly articulate differentiators against hyperscalers and specialized competitors.

Sales Leadership & People Management

Microsoft managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by Modeling, Coaching and Caring
:

Model: Embody Microsoft leadership principles, customer obsession, integrity, and inclusiveness.
Coach: Set clear revenue targets and performance expectations, support deal strategy, help sellers adapt, learn and improve continuously.
Care: Attract, develop, and retain great sales talent; understand individual motivations; and support team members’ career growth.

Concrete Expectations

Build a strong, high‑performing sales culture: discipline in forecasting, usage of tools (MSX, CRM), robust pipeline management.
Establish a consistent coaching rhythm (1:1s, forecast reviews, opportunity strategy sessions, joint customer engagements).
Help sellers strengthen their executive communication skills—ensuring compelling, outcome‑focused conversations with Finance Sector leaders.

Sales Strategy & Pipeline Management

Own Cloud & AI revenue results for the territory: pipeline health, forecasting accuracy, bookings, consumption growth, and renewal performance.
Guide teams in building and maintaining high-quality pipelines with sufficient coverage, leveraging data (propensity, consumption trends, renewal risk, competitive signals) to prioritize and optimize effort.
Lead regular pipeline and forecast reviews with internal stakeholders, ensuring data‑driven decision making and early risk identification.
Ensure disciplined execution of sales plays aligned with Microsoft’s Cloud & AI priorities (modernization, data & AI, digital sovereignty, cybersecurity, app innovation, etc.).
Drive whitespace analysis and identify new growth vectors across industries

Account Strategy & Cross‑Team Collaboration

Partner closely with Account Executives (AEs) to strengthen account strategies and ensure Cloud & AI sales motions are fully embedded in the account plans.
Collaborate with Customer Success, Marketing, Partner teams and industry specialists to maximize impact, support strategic engagements, and ensure value realization for customers.
Foster strong collaboration with the partner ecosystem (GSIs, local integrators, software vendors, start‑ups) to drive differentiated, customer‑aligned solutions.
Ensure storytelling, customer references, and ecosystem success stories are captured and shared to fuel future wins.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Information Security, or related field AND 8+ years experience in technology-related sales or account management OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Management, Engineering, or any relevant field — OR equivalent practical experience.
Experience in complex enterprise sales, ideally in cloud, software, digital transformation, or technology markets.
Experience leading sales teams, including field sellers and/or virtual teams in competitive, high‑stakes environments.
Demonstrated experience selling to regulated industries, with strong understanding of procurement cycles, governance, and compliance requirements.
Proven ability to manage large opportunities and multi‑million‑euro deal cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
Executive presence and communication skills; ability to simplify complex value propositions and engage Finance Sector leadership.
Data‑driven mindset applied to forecasting, pipeline analysis, and revenue planning.

jobs.title: Vice President Finance
jobs.description:
An established organization in Toronto, Canada is seeking an accomplished finance executive to take responsibility for its financial management, operational performance, and long-term financial planning.
This senior leadership opportunity combines financial oversight with active involvement in business operations. The successful candidate will bring sound financial judgment, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to translate financial information into practical business improvements.
The position requires an experienced leader who can balance strategic priorities with the day-to-day financial demands of a manufacturing environment, strengthen financial discipline, and contribute directly to business performance.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Finance and Business Leadership
Provide direction and oversight across the finance function, ensuring financial activities support operational priorities and broader business objectives.
Partner with senior management to evaluate financial performance, identify business opportunities, and support decisions affecting profitability and growth.
Establish meaningful financial performance measures and provide clear recommendations to support effective decision-making.
Assess the financial implications of major operational initiatives, business investments, and improvement programs.
Promote financial accountability and commercially informed decision-making throughout the organization.

Financial Planning, Analysis and Performance

Direct the preparation of annual budgets, periodic forecasts, and longer-term financial plans.
Evaluate financial results against operating plans, investigate material variances, and recommend appropriate actions.
Develop financial models and business cases to evaluate investment decisions, operating alternatives, and potential risks.
Provide management with timely insights into profitability, cost trends, margins, and financial performance.
Establish effective forecasting and performance-monitoring processes that support business planning.

Cash Flow and Working Capital

Oversee cash flow forecasting and liquidity planning to support ongoing operations and anticipated business requirements.
Monitor the financial impact of receivables, payables, inventory, operating expenditures, and capital commitments.
Identify opportunities to improve cash conversion, working capital utilization, and financial efficiency.
Evaluate financing requirements and potential financial exposures, recommending appropriate management actions.

Operational Finance and Cost Management

Provide financial expertise to support manufacturing operations, cost management, and operational planning.
Oversee product costing methodologies, inventory valuation, cost allocations, and analysis of manufacturing performance.
Evaluate operating costs, production variances, resource utilization, and profitability drivers to identify improvement opportunities.
Collaborate with operational management to assess productivity initiatives, process improvements, and cost optimization opportunities.
Support the financial assessment of capital expenditures, equipment investments, and other operational projects.
Maintain effective financial oversight of inventory-related transactions, valuation practices, and associated controls.

Financial Reporting, Governance and Risk

Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of financial and management reporting.
Maintain appropriate accounting practices and reporting procedures in accordance with applicable financial reporting requirements.
Establish and strengthen internal financial controls, policies, and governance procedures.
Coordinate financial audit activities and support compliance with applicable tax, statutory, and corporate requirements.
Identify significant financial risks and develop practical measures to address them.
Evaluate opportunities to improve financial systems, reporting processes, data quality, and operational efficiency.

Team Leadership and Organizational Development

Lead and develop a capable finance team with a clear focus on performance, accountability, and professional development.
Establish clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and effective working relationships within the finance function.
Provide coaching and development opportunities while supporting succession planning and organizational capability.
Encourage collaboration between finance and other business functions to improve the quality and timeliness of financial information.
Foster a culture of integrity, continuous improvement, and results-oriented performance.

Qualifications and Experience

Essential Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
At least 10 years of progressive experience in finance, including substantial responsibility for financial management and team leadership.
Demonstrated senior financial leadership experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
Strong technical knowledge of manufacturing finance, including product costing, inventory accounting, operational cost analysis, and financial reporting.
Extensive experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial planning and analysis, cash flow management, and working capital optimization.
Sound understanding of applicable accounting standards, financial controls, audit practices, and financial governance.
Proven ability to improve financial performance through effective cost management, operational analysis, and financial planning.
Practical experience using enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems and integrated financial reporting tools.
Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with operational leaders and influence business decisions.
Experience managing, mentoring, and developing finance professionals.

Preferred Qualifications

CPA, CA, or an equivalent recognized professional accounting designation.
MBA or another relevant postgraduate qualification.
Experience in complex or regulated industrial environments.
Involvement in financial systems implementations, reporting improvements, or organizational transformation initiatives.
Demonstrated success in improving operating margins, working capital performance, or financial processes.

Leadership Attributes

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong business judgment, integrity, and accountability, together with excellent analytical and interpersonal skills.
We are seeking an individual who is comfortable working with senior stakeholders, addressing complex financial challenges, and balancing strategic considerations with practical operational requirements.
The ability to develop constructive working relationships, communicate financial information clearly, and lead organizational improvements will be essential.

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

new_jobs.title: Sales Director for Cloud & AI
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Overview

Are you curious and deeply passionate about technology and sales, and ready to tackle complex challenges in a dynamic environment in the era of AI? Are you passionate about empowering financial sector customers to achieve more with technology and help them succeed in their digital transformation?If so, we invite you to join our Canadian team as a Solution Sales Director for Cloud & AI
at Microsoft. In this role, you will be at the forefront of innovation, working on cutting‑edge projects that leverage the latest cloud and AI technologies to drive meaningful impact for citizens and a variety of industries. Join us and be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning. Microsoft believes that our Canadian organizations have a unique opportunity to transform society at scale. From central government and agencies to local authorities, healthcare institutions and education, these organizations are reinventing how they deliver secure, trusted and efficient services to citizens. With Microsoft Cloud, we aspire to empower every finance sector organization to innovate and modernize on our platform, while meeting the highest standards of security, compliance and digital sovereignty.

Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Deal Execution

Lead the sales team responsible for driving Cloud & AI revenue across accounts, ensuring disciplined execution of the end‑to‑end sales cycle (prospection → qualification → deal shaping → closing).
Ensure teams adhere to Microsoft sales methodologies (including AI‑enhanced sales frameworks) to qualify opportunities, accelerate deal velocity and improve win rates.
Orchestrate complex deal cycles involving procurement, multi‑stakeholder governance, and compliance constraints typical of the French Financial Sector.
Coach sellers on how to engage, influence and secure executive alignment with C‑level decision makers (CEO, CIO, CTO/CDO, Business Line Leaders) to land Microsoft Cloud value propositions.
Drive competitive positioning, ensuring the team can clearly articulate differentiators against hyperscalers and specialized competitors.

Sales Leadership & People Management

Microsoft managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by Modeling, Coaching and Caring
:

Model: Embody Microsoft leadership principles, customer obsession, integrity, and inclusiveness.
Coach: Set clear revenue targets and performance expectations, support deal strategy, help sellers adapt, learn and improve continuously.
Care: Attract, develop, and retain great sales talent; understand individual motivations; and support team members’ career growth.

Concrete Expectations

Build a strong, high‑performing sales culture: discipline in forecasting, usage of tools (MSX, CRM), robust pipeline management.
Establish a consistent coaching rhythm (1:1s, forecast reviews, opportunity strategy sessions, joint customer engagements).
Help sellers strengthen their executive communication skills—ensuring compelling, outcome‑focused conversations with Finance Sector leaders.

Sales Strategy & Pipeline Management

Own Cloud & AI revenue results for the territory: pipeline health, forecasting accuracy, bookings, consumption growth, and renewal performance.
Guide teams in building and maintaining high-quality pipelines with sufficient coverage, leveraging data (propensity, consumption trends, renewal risk, competitive signals) to prioritize and optimize effort.
Lead regular pipeline and forecast reviews with internal stakeholders, ensuring data‑driven decision making and early risk identification.
Ensure disciplined execution of sales plays aligned with Microsoft’s Cloud & AI priorities (modernization, data & AI, digital sovereignty, cybersecurity, app innovation, etc.).
Drive whitespace analysis and identify new growth vectors across industries

Account Strategy & Cross‑Team Collaboration

Partner closely with Account Executives (AEs) to strengthen account strategies and ensure Cloud & AI sales motions are fully embedded in the account plans.
Collaborate with Customer Success, Marketing, Partner teams and industry specialists to maximize impact, support strategic engagements, and ensure value realization for customers.
Foster strong collaboration with the partner ecosystem (GSIs, local integrators, software vendors, start‑ups) to drive differentiated, customer‑aligned solutions.
Ensure storytelling, customer references, and ecosystem success stories are captured and shared to fuel future wins.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Information Security, or related field AND 8+ years experience in technology-related sales or account management OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Management, Engineering, or any relevant field — OR equivalent practical experience.
Experience in complex enterprise sales, ideally in cloud, software, digital transformation, or technology markets.
Experience leading sales teams, including field sellers and/or virtual teams in competitive, high‑stakes environments.
Demonstrated experience selling to regulated industries, with strong understanding of procurement cycles, governance, and compliance requirements.
Proven ability to manage large opportunities and multi‑million‑euro deal cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
Executive presence and communication skills; ability to simplify complex value propositions and engage Finance Sector leadership.
Data‑driven mindset applied to forecasting, pipeline analysis, and revenue planning.
